name: Motionmaxxed
tagline: Motionmaxxing's film: near-black ground, sentence-case neo-grotesk, one accent, cuts every 0.3–2.3 s.

motion.direction: Made by a motion designer, not a deck. Sentence case or lowercase, weight 500 feel: headline lines of 2–4 words at 9 % of the frame (about 170 px), a supporting line at 5–7 % (100–130 px), one hero number (`counter`, 300–420 px) used once. Nothing grows from zero: arrivals start oversize and decelerate into place; exits accelerate out; cut on motion every 0.3–2.3 s. A new word may flash in `ter` then the next line returns to `iv`. Centre the statements (left 70, w 940, align center). No kickers, no uppercase tracked labels, no corner labels, no "02 / 05" chapter numbering, no stamps, no patterns, no cards floating on a void.
